genxml.title: two-wire addresses the host driver of the Origin 2000 module controller uses
genxml.doc: Two-wire device addresses the host driver of the Origin 2000 module controller uses: what the host-side driver for the module system controller (the MSC, also called ELSC) passes as the device argument of its two-wire transfers, and how it builds the one that varies. Everything here is read from the host driver object; the controller's own firmware is not held, so what sits behind each address is a reading, not a finding. The device argument is a 7-bit address when the transfer routine takes it as one; the routine is in the kernel, not in the object, so that form is inferred.
